description: S458 slice 2 (position 8): a LITERAL argument to a refined parameter is decided at compile time. `rate(150)` against `score: number(>=0 && <=100)` is E-CONTRACT-001. Before S458 the literal compiled clean and failed only at run time, in the callee's entry check.
rationale: §53.4.2 rule 1 (a numeric literal is statically decided); §53.3.1 "at every assignment or binding site"; §53.12.3: "Call site: 10 is a literal, 10 > 0 && 10 < 500 — static zone, no check".
